DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品について、どのような点をお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to ask about this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から勧められましたが、言葉の意味が分かりません。まず説明を聞きたくて来たので、今すぐ申し込むつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勧奨された商品は用語不明で説明希望のみ即申込意志なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family recommended it, but I do not understand the terminology. I came to hear an explanation first, so I do not intend to apply right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you only want an explanation of the recommended product because you do not understand its terminology, and that you do not intend to apply immediately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 説明のご希望として伺います。どの言葉が分かりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will take this as a request for an explanation. Which term do you not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙の「元本」です。知ったふりでうなずくと、内容を了承したように見えそうで心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元本の語を示し理解したふりの同意を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The term ‘principal’ on this paper. I am worried that nodding as though I understand might make it look as if I have agreed to the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the term ‘principal’ and say that you want to avoid pretending to understand and thereby appearing to agree. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用語と商品の条件を、担当が分けてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will explain the terminology and the product conditions separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。言葉が分かっただけで、この商品が自分に合うと判断したことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用語理解を本人適合判断と同一にしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Simply understanding the words does not mean I have decided this product suits me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that understanding the terminology is not the same as deciding the product is suitable for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご質問の後に、資料を持ち帰るご希望もお伝えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After your questions, you can also tell us if you would like to take the materials home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち帰って考えたいです。家族が勧めたことと、私自身が決めたことを分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料持帰り希望で家族勧奨と自己決定を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to take them home and think it over. I want to distinguish my family's recommendation from my own decision.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to take the materials home and distinguish your family's recommendation from your own decision. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込みの意思は、説明の確認後に改めて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask again whether you wish to apply after you have checked the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は質問と資料の確認にします。署名を求められたら、何の書類か先に聞いてから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回は質問と資料確認で署名前に書類目的を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I will just ask questions and check the materials. If I am asked to sign, I will first ask what the document is for, then decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that this visit is for questions and checking the materials, and that before signing you will ask the purpose of the document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 説明のみのご希望を担当へお伝えします。それでは、資料をお持ちのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person responsible that you only want an explanation. Please wait with your materials in hand. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 職場で分けるお菓子をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for sweets to share at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。十人の職場ですが、今日は八人です。一人に一つずつ渡せる箱はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日八人に一個ずつ渡せる箱を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There are ten people at work, but eight are there today. Do you have a box that will let me give one to each person?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a box containing enough to give one each to the eight people present today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この箱は八個入りで、一つずつ包んであります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This box contains eight, individually wrapped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ちょうどよさそうです。休みの二人には別の日に買います。どのくらい日持ちしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八個箱を候補にし欠勤者分は後日購入して期限を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That sounds just right. I will buy some another day for the two people who are off. How long will these keep?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Consider the eight-piece box, say you will buy for the absent people another day, and ask about the expiry date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期限はこの側面をご覧ください。保存方法も、その下に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the expiry date on this side. The storage instructions are written below it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今週金曜日までですね。今日の午後に配るので、この箱にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限表示を確認し当日配布用に購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: They keep until this Friday, then. I will hand them out this afternoon, so I will take this box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the expiry date shown and decide to buy the box to hand out today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの箱でよろしいですね。持ち運びの袋は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This box, then? Do you need a bag to carry it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。歩いて持っていくので、箱が傾きにくい袋があると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩持運び用に箱が傾きにくい袋を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I will be walking, so a bag that keeps the box from tilting would help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a bag that will keep the box from tilting while you carry it on foot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この袋なら底に置けます。レジでお会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It can sit on the bottom of this bag. Please pay at the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。袋へ平らに入れて、職場へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を平らに入れて職場へ持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will put the box flat in the bag and take it to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put the box flat in the bag and take it to work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 皆様でお楽しみください。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you all enjoy them. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチを動かそうとされていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you trying to move the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日が当たるので、木の下へ引けば涼しくなると思いました。でも、ここから動かしてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日陰へベンチを引きたいが移動許可不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is in the sun, so I thought pulling it under the tree would make it cooler. But I do not know whether it is all right to move it from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to pull the bench into the shade but do not know whether moving it is permitted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で動かさず、休む場所を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not move it yourself. Ask us about somewhere to rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まだ引いていません。友達も手伝うと言いましたが、二人で運べることが許可の意味にはなりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未移動で友人協力や二人運搬可能を許可根拠としないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: All right. I have not pulled it yet. My friend offered to help, but being able to carry it between us does not mean we have permission, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not moved it and that a friend's help or two people being able to carry it is no basis for permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日陰の場所をお探しなのですね。今の案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You are looking for somewhere in the shade, then. Let us check the current guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。木の根の上へ置けばよいと決めず、設置場所と歩く人の道も変わると考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 根上設置を自己決定せず設置と通行への影響も考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I will not decide myself that it can go on the tree roots; I will consider how its placement and the path for people walking would change too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not decide on your own to put it on the roots and will consider the effects on its placement and pedestrian passage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの休憩場所を利用できるか、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will let you know whether another rest area is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。先に友達へ、ベンチは動かさないと伝えます。自分たちが座りたい場所だけを優先しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ移動中止を先に知らせ自分の希望だけで決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. First I will tell my friend we are not moving the bench. We will not give priority only to where we want to sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will first tell your friend to stop the move and will not decide solely on your own preference. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内した場所でも、その時の利用状況をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check how busy the place we suggest is when you get there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物をまとめてから移り、空いていなければ別の方法を相談します。ベンチを運ぶ計画はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を持ち別休憩案内へ移り満席なら再相談し運搬計画を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We will gather our belongings before moving, and if there is no space, we will ask about another option. We will abandon the plan to carry the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take your belongings to the suggested rest area, ask again if it is full, and abandon the plan to carry the bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、ご案内の場所で無理なくお休みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please rest comfortably at the place we suggested. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗る列車をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the train to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。放送で列車の名前が聞こえませんでした。携帯で録音していましたが、人の声が重なって分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞き逃した列車名を雑音のある録音で確認できず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I could not catch the train name in the announcement. I recorded it on my phone, but other people's voices overlap, so I cannot make it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because you missed the train name and cannot check it in a noisy recording. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらまで行かれますか。お持ちの切符も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where are you going? Let us check your ticket too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅までです。切符には行き先がありますが、放送の列車名と同じか自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符の行先を示し放送列車名との対応が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: To this station. The destination is on the ticket, but I cannot tell whether it matches the train name in the announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination on your ticket and say you do not know how it corresponds to the announced train name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掲示の行き先と時刻を一緒に確認できます。何時ごろ出発する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check the destinations and times on the display together. Around what time are you planning to leave?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この時間の列車を考えています。録音を何度も聞いているうちに、出発に間に合わなくなるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定時間を示し録音反復で乗り遅れそうな心配を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am considering the train at this time. I am worried I will miss departure while repeatedly listening to the recording.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your planned departure time and explain your concern that repeatedly listening to the recording may make you miss the train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず掲示で候補を確かめましょう。その後、乗り場の案内も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: First let us check the possible trains on the display. Then we will check the platform information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。前の放送が遅れの案内だったのか、乗り場の案内だったのかも混ざってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅延と乗場案内を聞き分けられなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I have also got confused about whether the earlier announcement was about a delay or the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you could not distinguish the delay announcement from the platform information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 録音の内容だけに頼らず、今の運行案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the current service information instead of relying only on the recording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今の時刻と行き先を掲示で照らし、分からない列車名はここで読み方を聞いてから乗り場へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現行掲示で行先時刻を照合し名称確認後に乗場へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will compare the current time and destination on the display, ask here how to read any train name I do not know, and then go to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match the destination and time against the current display and go to the platform after confirming the name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、掲示をご案内します。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you the display. Please take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の案内についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about local information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋に残っていた地区の集まりの予定表を見ました。参加したいのですが、何年の案内か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年不明の地区行事案内を見て参加先を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a schedule for neighborhood gatherings that was left in my room. I would like to take part, but I do not know which year's notice it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to inquire about participation after finding a neighborhood event notice with no clear year. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付や、問い合わせ先が載っている部分を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the part with the date or contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここです。月と日はありますが、年はなく、場所も以前の集会所らしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 年の欠落と旧集会所らしい場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. It has the month and day but no year, and the venue seems to be the former community hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the year is missing and the venue appears to be the old community hall. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この紙だけでは今の開催予定は分かりません。お住まいの地区を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This paper alone does not tell us the current schedule. Please tell me which neighborhood you live in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この住所の地区です。先に現在の案内を確認できる窓口を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所で地区を示し現行案内の確認先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The neighborhood at this address. First I would like to know the office where I can check the current information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify your neighborhood using your address and ask where to check the current notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地域の活動について相談する担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will connect you with the person who handles inquiries about community activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。集まりの名前をうまく読めないので、紙も一緒に持っていってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読みにくい行事名のため原紙持参の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I cannot quite read the name of the gathering. May I take the paper with me too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may bring the original paper because the event name is difficult to read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、案内の確認にお使いください。参加の方法もそこでお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please use it to check the information. Ask there how to participate too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。古い場所へ直接行く前に、今年の日程と初めて参加する人の手続きを聞いてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今年の日程と初参加手続きを確認してから訪ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Before going directly to the old venue, I will ask about this year's schedule and the procedures for first-time participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check this year's schedule and the procedures for first-time participants before visiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当の窓口へご案内します。よい機会になるといいですね。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the relevant desk. I hope it turns out to be a good opportunity for you. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything we can help you with at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 周りがにぎやかだと、呼ばれた名前を聞き取れません。診察を待つ間の呼び出しを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雑音の中で名前を聞き取れず呼び出し方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: When it is noisy around me, I cannot make out my name being called. I would like to discuss how I will be called while waiting for my consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot make out your name amid noise and ask about how you will be called. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 聞き取りやすい方法や、普段の工夫を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us what makes it easier for you to hear, or what you usually do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目の前で話してもらうと分かりやすいです。掲示も見られますが、今日はどこを見ればよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対面説明が分かりやすく掲示の見る場所が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is easier to understand when someone speaks directly in front of me. I can look at a display too, but I do not know where to look today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that face-to-face explanations are easier to understand and you do not know which display to watch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで対応できる方法を確認します。少しお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check what we can do here. Could you wait a moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。大きな声なら必ず聞こえるというわけではないので、顔を見て話していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 声量より顔を見て話す方法を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. A louder voice does not necessarily mean I will hear, so it would help if you faced me when speaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for people to face you when speaking rather than relying on volume. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に伝えます。ご同行の方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the person responsible. Is anyone accompanying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一人です。呼ばれるのが心配で入口に立ち続けるのではなく、座って待てる方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単独来院で座って待てる対応を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am alone today. Rather than keep standing by the entrance worrying about being called, I would like to know a way I can sit and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you came alone and would like an arrangement that lets you sit while waiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待つ場所と呼び出しの方法を確認して、ご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check where you should wait and how we will call you, then explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。説明を聞いてから席を選びます。聞き取れなかった時は、その場で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機説明後に席を選び聞き逃しは再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I will choose a seat after hearing the explanation. If I do not catch something, I will check at the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose a seat after the waiting arrangements are explained and check again if you miss something. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、確認できるまでこちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here until I can confirm the arrangements. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちのチラシについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about the flyer you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このチラシを職場で配ろうと思いましたが、警察が出したものか分かりません。確認先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 警察名義に見える配布物の出所を印刷前に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was thinking of handing this flyer out at work, but I do not know whether it was issued by the police. Please tell me where I can check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the source of material that appears to bear the police's name before printing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらで手に入れましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 知り合いから画像でもらいました。下の部分が切れていて、日付や問い合わせ先が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知人から受領した画像で日付と問合先が切れていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: An acquaintance sent me an image. The bottom is cut off, so I cannot see the date or contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that an acquaintance sent the image and the date and contact details have been cropped off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この画像だけで出所を確かめるのは難しいですね。元の資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is difficult to establish the source from this image alone. Do you have the original material?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありません。警察の名前があるので本物と思いましたが、まだ印刷はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原資料未所持で警察名のみから信用しかけたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I thought it was genuine because it has the police's name on it, but I have not printed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not have the original and were about to trust it solely because of the police's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認に使える情報を整理しましょう。どのような内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us organize the information we can use to check. What is it about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自転車についての注意です。職場の人が読めるように翻訳もしたいですが、まず原文の出所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自転車注意の翻訳配布希望だが原文の出所確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It gives advice about bicycles. I would also like to translate it so people at work can read it, but first I want to know the source of the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to translate and distribute the bicycle advice but will first check the original's source. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる窓口や資料を調べてご案内します。未確認のまま配らないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will look up offices or materials that can help verify it and guide you. Please do not distribute it while it remains unverified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。画像を送った人にも全体の資料を尋ねます。出所が分かってから、引用する範囲と翻訳の内容を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送信者に全体資料を聞き出所判明後に利用範囲を検討すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I will also ask the person who sent the image for the complete material. Once I know the source, I will consider how much to quote and what to include in the translation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the sender for the complete material and consider the scope of use after identifying the source. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、確認先をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell you where to check. Thank you for consulting us. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の発送でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一度開けた箱を使っています。ふたが少し曲がっているので、この状態で預けられるか見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再利用箱の曲がったふたを示し発送可能な状態か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am using a box that has been opened before. The lid is a little bent, so I would like you to check whether I can hand it over in this condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the bent lid of a reused box and ask whether its condition is suitable for shipping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容品と、箱の内側の状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what is inside and what condition the inside of the box is in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本が三冊です。中は乾いていますが、ふたの端がうまく重なりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本三冊で内部は乾燥しているがふたが合わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three books. The inside is dry, but the edges of the lid do not meet properly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there are three books and the inside is dry, but the lid does not fit together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱の状態を確認します。まだ閉じないでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the box's condition. Could you leave it open for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。テープを増やす前に見てもらいます。本が動く隙間もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉じる前に確認を頼み内容品が動く隙間も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will have you look before adding more tape. There is also space for the books to move around.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a check before closing it and mention the space in which the contents can move. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中で動かないようにする方法と、箱の選び方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain how to stop the contents moving and how to choose a box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は材料を持っていません。ここで用意できる物と、持ち帰って準備する場合の違いを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 材料未持参で窓口準備と自宅準備の選択肢を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not brought any materials today. I would like to know the difference between what I can get here and taking it home to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have brought no packing materials and ask about preparing it at the counter or at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用意できる物や費用を確認してから、方法をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose a method after checking the materials available and their costs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、まず案内をお願いします。箱を替えるなら本も入れ直して、準備ができてから発送を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料と費用の説明後に梱包を完成させ発送すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please explain first. If I change the box, I will repack the books too and ask for shipment once everything is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will finish packing and send it after hearing about the materials and costs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、梱包の相談からご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will start with advice on packing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の記録について、ご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like some guidance on your account records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座から出たお金を、共同生活の分と自分の買い物に分けて整理したいです。明細の見方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同生活費と個人購入を分けるため明細の読み方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to organize the money paid out of my account into shared living expenses and my own purchases. Please explain how to read the statement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to read the statement so you can separate shared living expenses from personal purchases. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取引の日付や金額は確認できますが、買った品物までは分からない場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check transaction dates and amounts, but the actual items purchased may not be identifiable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: なるほど。店の名前が出ていても、共同で使う物を買った証拠になるとは限りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店名のみでは共同用途の証明にならないと理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. Even if the shop's name appears, that does not necessarily prove that I bought things for shared use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand that a shop name alone does not prove a shared purpose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身のレシートなどと照らし合わせる必要があります。どの期間の明細が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You will need to compare it with your own receipts and so on. Which period do you need a statement for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先月一か月分です。二人で生活費を出しているので、私の口座から払った分だけをまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先月の自分口座支払分だけ整理したいと期間を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The whole of last month. The two of us contribute to living expenses, so I want to total only the amounts paid from my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify last month and say you want to organize only payments from your own account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる方法と、記録の出し方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain how to check and obtain the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。相手の口座の情報もここで調べられると思っていましたが、今日は自分の記録について相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の口座ではなく自分の記録の相談と範囲を定める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I had thought I could look up the other person's account information here too, but today I will ask about my own records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit the inquiry to your own records rather than the other person's account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この口座について、ご本人の確認をしてからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will verify your identity before providing guidance on this account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の明細を受け取り、用途が分からないものは家でレシートと照合します。相手には別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分明細をレシートと照合し相手分は本人に尋ねると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will get my own statement and compare any unclear expenses with receipts at home. I will check with the other person separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will compare your statement with receipts and ask the other person directly about their share. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご本人確認から進めます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will begin by verifying your identity. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この箱を買いたいのですが、持ち上げると重くて、レジまで抱えて行けそうにありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 果物箱を持てずレジまでの運搬支援を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy this box, but when I lift it, it is so heavy that I do not think I can carry it in my arms to the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help carrying the fruit box to the register because you cannot carry it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に持ち上げず、そのまま置いてください。お運びする方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave it where it is without straining to lift it. I will check how we can move it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。片手で持とうとしてやめました。箱はまだこの棚の下にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち上げを中止し棚下の箱の位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I started trying to carry it with one hand but stopped. The box is still under this shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you stopped lifting it and explain that the box is under the shelf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カートなどを使えるか確認します。ほかにも購入する物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether we can use a cart or something similar. Are you buying anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 卵も買います。重い箱の下に入れないよう、別に置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 卵も買うので重量品と別置きを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Eggs too. I would like to keep them separate so they do not end up under the heavy box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are also buying eggs and want them kept separate from the heavy item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運び方と、会計の時の置き方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain how to move them and where to put them at checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。会計のあとも重いので、出口までどう運べるか一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計後の出口までの運搬方法も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. It will still be heavy after checkout, so I would also like to ask how I can get it to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to transport it to the exit after checkout too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口までの方法を確認します。お帰りの移動手段は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check how we can get it to the exit. How will you be traveling home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 迎えの車です。到着してから積むので、先に案内を聞いて、店内で待てる場所があるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 迎えの車までの待機場所と積み込み前の案内を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: A car is coming to pick me up. I will load it after the car arrives, so I would like to hear the instructions first and ask whether there is somewhere I can wait inside the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about somewhere to wait for the car picking you up and guidance before loading it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。それでは、まずレジまでの運び方を確認します。お買い物をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First I will check how to get it to the register. Enjoy your shopping. Excuse me.
